
# Whats

- What is this class about?
	- this class is about the different areas of SLA
	- this class is about research conducted in the different areas of SLA
	- this class is about the relationship bilingualism and cognitive processes
	- this class is about how languages are learned
- What do I want students to learn
	- basic understanding of field

	- solid intro to critiqueing research
